translationRepairs: In spring, the first month, Wang Jingze was made Grand Cavalry General and Minister of Works; Chen Xianda was made General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jiang Province.
In spring, the first month, Grand Cavalry General Wang Jingze was made Minister of Works; General Who Pacifies the Army Chen Xianda was made Governor of Jiang Province.
以驃騎大將軍王敬則為司空 names an already titled officer and confers 司空; the original treats 驃騎大將軍 as newly given.
When the emperor heard of it, he appointed Cui Huijing Right Guards General and Governor of Yu Province to guard against it.
When the emperor heard of it, he appointed Right Guards General Cui Huijing Governor of Yu Province to guard against it.
以右衛將軍崔慧景為豫州刺史 confers 豫州刺史 on a man already titled 右衛將軍; the original invents a dual appointment.
Xing Luan was a grandson of Xing Shuo.
Xing Luan was a grandson of Xing Ying.
穎 is Ying; Shuo would be 朔, so Xing Shuo is a wrong given-name reading.
Luan was the grandson of Xing Shuo.
Luan was the grandson of Xing Ying.
The literal likewise renders 穎 as Shuo; Xing Ying matches the graph and pinyin Yǐng.
On bingzi, Crown Prince Wenhuiz Changmao died.
On bingzi, Crown Prince Wenhui Changmao died.
文惠 is Wenhui; Wenhuiz is a stray letter not present in the Chinese title.

In summer, the fourth month, on jiawu, Prince Zhaoye of Nan Commandery was named imperial great-grandson; Eastern Palace officials were retitled as great-grandson staff; the late crown prince's consort, Lady Wang of Langye, became great-grandson grand consort; and Prince Zhaoye's consort, Lady He, became great-grandson consort.

In summer, the fourth month, on jiawu, Prince Zhaoye of Nan Commandery was named imperial grandson; Eastern Palace officials were retitled as imperial-grandson staff; the late crown prince's consort, Lady Wang of Langye, became grand consort to the imperial grandson; and Prince Zhaoye's consort, Lady He, became consort of the imperial grandson.
皇太孫 is the emperor's grandson, the late crown prince's son, not a great-grandson.

In summer, the fourth month, on jiawu, Prince of Nanjun Zhaoye was established as imperial great-grandson; all Eastern Palace civil and military offices were changed to great-grandson staff; the crown prince's consort, Lady Wang of Langye, was made great-grandson grand consort; the Prince of Nanjun's consort, Lady He, was made great-grandson consort.

In summer, the fourth month, on jiawu, Prince of Nanjun Zhaoye was established as imperial grandson; all Eastern Palace civil and military offices were changed to imperial-grandson staff; the crown prince's consort, Lady Wang of Langye, was made grand consort to the imperial grandson; the Prince of Nanjun's consort, Lady He, was made consort of the imperial grandson.
太孫官屬 and 皇太孫妃 likewise belong to the imperial grandson, not a great-grandson.
Lady He was a daughter of the Ji clan.
Lady He was a daughter of Ji.
Parallel 後，熙之女也 shows 戢 is the father's given name, not a clan name Ji.
In the past Cao Cao defeated Yuan Shao with ten thousand exhausted troops, and Xie Xuan crushed Fu Qin's army with three thousand infantry—the outcome turns in a moment, not on numbers alone."

In the past Cao Cao defeated Yuan Shao with ten thousand exhausted troops, and Xie Xuan crushed the army of Former Qin with three thousand infantry—the outcome turns in a moment, not on numbers alone."
苻秦 is the Former Qin state; the next sentence's 苻氏 confirms a polity, not a person Fu Qin.
On the day dingwei the Wei emperor held a military review and put Minister of Works Li Chong in charge of selecting troops.
On the day dingwei the Wei emperor held a military review and put Minister of the Masters of Writing Li Chong in charge of selecting troops.
尚書李沖 is a Master of Writing, not 司空; Minister of Works would be a different office.
On dingwei the Wei sovereign held a military review and ordered Minister of Works Li Chong to oversee selection for martial service.
On dingwei the Wei sovereign held a military review and ordered Minister of the Masters of Writing Li Chong to oversee selection for martial service.
The literal repeats the same 尚書-as-司空 error for 李沖.
Governor Wang Xuanyao put down the revolt and executed the ringleaders.
Governor Wang Xuanmiao put down the revolt and executed the ringleaders.
邈 is miǎo; Xuanyao misreads 王玄邈 as if 邈 were yào.
Governor Wang Xuanyao suppressed and executed them.
Governor Wang Xuanmiao suppressed and executed them.
The literal has the same wrong reading of 邈; Xuanmiao is the correct romanization.

Before long the emperor revived and asked where the crown prince was; he then summoned the Eastern Palace guard, weapons and all, and entrusted court affairs to Left Vice Minister of Works, Marquis of Xichang, Luan.

Before long the emperor revived and asked where the crown prince was; he then summoned the Eastern Palace guard, weapons and all, and entrusted court affairs to Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, Marquis of Xichang, Luan.
尚書左僕射 is Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, not Vice Minister of Works (司空).

Shortly after, the emperor revived and asked where the crown prince was; he then summoned the Eastern Palace guards with their weapons inside and entrusted court affairs to Left Vice Minister of Works, Marquis of Xichang, Luan.

Shortly after, the emperor revived and asked where the crown prince was; he then summoned the Eastern Palace guards with their weapons inside and entrusted court affairs to Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, Marquis of Xichang, Luan.
The literal likewise misidentifies 尚書左僕射 as a Works ministry post.
Rong saw that his plan had failed, changed out of mourning dress, returned to the Secretariat, and sighed, "My lord, you have led me astray!"
Rong saw that his plan had failed, changed out of martial dress, returned to the Secretariat, and sighed, "My lord, you have led me astray!"
s0150 has 戎服絳衫; 釋服 is discarding that martial dress, not mourning clothes.
Rong knew his plan had failed; he changed back from mourning dress and returned to the Secretariat, sighing: "My lord—you have ruined me!"
Rong knew his plan had failed; he changed back from martial dress and returned to the Secretariat, sighing: "My lord—you have ruined me!"
The literal's mourning dress contradicts the scarlet battle shirt Wang Rong was wearing.
Prince of Wuling Ye declared loudly before the assembly: "If a commoner is to be enthroned, it ought to be me;
Prince of Wuling Ye declared loudly before the assembly: "If a lesser prince is to be enthroned, it ought to be me;
立民 is opposed to 立嫡 and means a cadet or lesser prince; Ye is not calling himself a commoner.
Left Vice Minister of Works, Marquis Luan of Xichang, was made Director of the Secretariat;
Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, Marquis Luan of Xichang, was made Director of the Secretariat;
尚書左僕射 again is the secretariat vice-directorate, not Minister of Works.
Left Vice Minister of Works, Marquis of Xichang Luan, became Director of the Secretariat;
Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, Marquis of Xichang Luan, became Director of the Secretariat;
The literal repeats the 僕射/司空 confusion at Luan's promotion to 尚書令.
